# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Before making non-trivial changes, read and follow the repository root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

`AGENTS.md` is the single source of truth for AI collaboration: operator-to-Track mapping, required read order, ownership boundaries, shared-interface rules, safety constraints, branch/PR workflow, and definition of done.

Do not infer a Track from the file currently open. Identify the human operator first. If the operator/Track is unknown, ask rather than guessing.

Then read the matching `docs/tracks/track-a.md`, `track-b.md`, `track-c.md`, or `track-d.md` and the current tracking Issue before editing.
